fixed_guards: ASSUMPTION and INFERENCE must never be promoted to FACT without a source or human answer.
Ask at most one highest-information-value question at a time.
Researchable facts must be researched instead of delegated to the user.
High-impact ambiguity keeps architecture, payment, legal consent, deletion, and production release fail-closed.
A later human answer invalidates conflicting assumptions and triggers impact-based regeneration.
